notes.title: Layers of Fear: the Series Crowning Work Is Coming out Next Month
notes.content:
Bloober Team's venture into horror began with the Layers series; the upcoming Layers of Fear will be the series' most important work and is scheduled to launch in June 2023. Developed in collaboration with Anshar Studios, it promises to deliver fresh gameplay, chapters, and a visually stunning experience. Here's a brief look at what awaits our dear players.

[h2]Game Content[/h2]

The series’ upcoming magnum opus is the definitive way to experience the critically acclaimed franchise as it features Layers of Fear and Layers of Fear 2, as well as all DLCs (including the new ‘The Final Note’ DLC that will give you a new perspective on the Layers of Fear storyline) and the never-before-told story of The Writer, which will tie everything together. Built on Unreal Engine 5, Layers of Fear supports Ray Tracing, HDR, and 4K resolution to make the stunning visuals, and your nightmarish experience, as immersive and realistic as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34866232/7f5ba1257926ee64f62f35db18789fcffb8fffa1.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Preview[/h2]

Check out our latest 11-minute gameplay video and get ready to immerse yourself in the horrors that await new players and long-time fans of the Layers of Fear series. Witness the unveiling of the new mechanic, the lantern, and take a sneak peek at the gameplay in a new setting — inside a lighthouse.

[previewyoutube=hVioJM_lKwU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Next-Generation Graphics[/h2]

In addition to introducing brand new chapters and gameplay elements, Layers of Fear also demonstrates the impressive potential of Unreal Engine 5 - it's one of the very first games to date that were built with the newest technology. Take a look at the game's stunning graphics in a showcase video here.

[previewyoutube=iMkN8whZQmQ;full][/previewyoutube]

There's much more to learn about the game, go check out the Layers of Fear's Steam card for more information. Keep a close eye there as our developers host streams about the game from time to time.

Don't forget to share your comments and insights in the comment section of the news. Thanks for following!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946700/Layers_of_Fear/

notes.title: Layers of Fear 2 - Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dyRQ4qetpAgQGQaN7X/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Layers of Fear 2 - Patch 1.2[/h1]

The team has prepared our second patch, deployed today, to address a few key issues found in Layers of Fear 2 on PC.

Patch 1.2
[list]
[*]FIXED - Formless Man - Various "Instant Death" Encounters
[*]FIXED - Various Lighting Issues
[*]TUNED - Further Fine Tuning of the Formless Man Behavior and Difficulty
[*]TUNED - Performance and Quality Adjustments
[*]TUNED - Pacing Adjustments - Several Acts
[*]TUNED - Black and White Post Processing - Adjusted in Chapter 2
[*]TUNED - Perfect Storm Achievement 
[*]NEW - 'NG+ Unlocked' Pop Up with Info Added to Game Ending
[/list]
This patch is now live, so please restart the title and check for updates!

-Layers of Fear 2 Dev Team

[h1]Layers of Fear 2 - Patch 1.1[/h1]

We have a hotfix patch incoming for Layers of Fear 2 on PC to repair and tune a few key elements uncovered in our first week, post-launch.

[b]Patch 1.1[/b]
[list]
[*]FIXED - Several Issues with Formless Man Behavior
[*]FIXED - Various Lighting Issues

[*]FIXED - Minor Bug Fixes in Multiple Acts
[*]FIXED - Letter Spacing for ъ, ь, э, я
[*]TUNED - Formless Man Difficulty Decreased
[*]TUNED - Max Value for FOV Increased by 5%
[*]TUNED - Default Controller Sensitivity Increased by 10%
[/list]

The patch will go live immediately, so please restart the title and check for updates!

-Layers of Fear 2 Dev Team

notes.title: Layers of Fear 2 - Out Now
notes.content:
[h1]Layers of Fear 2 - Out Now[/h1]

Experience Bloober Team's New Masterpiece, Layers of Fear 2, with voice acting led by iconic horror actor Tony Todd. Available now on Steam.

Layers of Fear 2 is a first-person psychological horror game with an emphasis on exploration and story. Players control a Hollywood actor who heeds the call of an enigmatic director to take on the lead role in a film shot aboard an ocean liner. Beware, for all may not truly be what it seems.

Click the image below for our all new launch trailer!

notes.title: Layers of Fear 2 - Steam Page and News to Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34866232/ccf920b2973d701187c1b80ab565506ba054600f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello, dear actors, and welcome to the crew of a new masterpiece in horror.
[/h1]
For those of you just encountering Layers of Fear 2 for the first time, allow us a moment to bring you up to date on the project.

Layers of Fear 2 is a first-person psychological horror game with an emphasis on exploration and story. Players control a Hollywood actor who heeds the call of an enigmatic director to take on the lead role in a film shot aboard an ocean liner. Beware, for all may not truly be what it seems.

[h1]Project Méliès[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34866232/4a156337afb4ab275fce02d178f9117dd8aaa353.jpg[/img]

Ominously teased, Project Méliès sneaked onto social media as the next project for Bloober Team, in partnership with Gun Media.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JvR1eCxP6eI

[h1]Project Méliès: Yet He Stands[/h1]

Shortly after the initial tease of Project Méliès, the team elaborated, even if only slightly. "Yet He Stands" clued keen eyed viewers into some of the key elements of the game, though hindsight helped immensely.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTUnw_XXA8s

[h1]Project Méliès - The Reveal[/h1]

The time had come to drop the code name and reveal what the team has been working on. Revealing not only that the title would be Layers of Fear 2, the second in the cult classic world created by Bloober Team, but also that Horror Icon Tony Todd was on board for narrating an especially eccentric main character.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UeMtj6CuXPE

[h1]Developer Diaries - Peeling Back the Curtain[/h1]

With an experience such as Layers of Fear 2, rich with inspiration and artistic elements from film to sound, Developer Diaries were then kicked off to document the process of creating such a lush but terrifying atmosphere.

Episode One deals with the inspiration behind Layers of Fear 2...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34866232/56358c4c495deeff4fbe36a67c1e4ebe6491a9f5.png[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QYHHxzKusxo

While Episode Two is a look at the Sound Design and Soundtrack of Layers of Fear 2...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34866232/c5e4e29b0263fd036a453f3d85f6a1e9b4fb2b3b.png[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X-YQqEOI8sA

[h1]PAX South and Presenting Layer of Fear 2 to the World[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34866232/2eabdccf475dab423e7794643c14c8b88b33eefd.jpg[/img]

With our first installment of the Dev Diary series ready to publish and a brand new exclusive trailer fresh from the fire, the teams at Bloober and Gun set out for a PAX South event featuring not only a VIP Party, set in a thematically accurate venue, but also a panel with the Design, Creative, and Community Team members on hand to lend some unique insight into the world of Layers of Fear 2.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/366740605][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/J6OJAKQQv6XfAJBU18/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view the PAX South Panel Broadcast Video[/i]

Our PAX South trailer premiere:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E3qOK26Bbig

[h1]PAX East and Our First Gameplay Demo[/h1]

Fast forward another month and we're on our way to PAX East, equipped with another VIP Event, in the theme of Layers of fear 2, another panel with team members from both Bloober and Gun, and this time a BOOTH. The booth featured a gameplay demo ripped straight from the game for our booth visitors to experience for themselves. 

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/403766780][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YoV7WrfSlDLJ0XEOjH/giphy.gif[/img][/url]
[i]Click the GIF to view the PAX East Panel Broadcast Video[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34866232/64cc2b4125edcaaa71eb5a57ed160b4cb4cdb4e5.jpg[/img]

And here we are. The team is incredibly proud of what we have with Layers of Fear 2 and cannot wait to show you more. 

We are currently on track for a launch in 2019 on PC, PS4, and Xbox One, with a $29.99 price point.
